Before: chicken wrap (~300 g, ~550 kcal), cola (~400 ml), oat cookie (~30 g, ~140 kcal).

After: the cookie is gone. About 35% of the wrap remains plus scattered filling, so roughly 60% of the wrap was eaten (~180 g, ~320 kcal). The cola is about half consumed, roughly 200 ml (~85 kcal).

Total: 320 + 140 + 85 ≈ 545 kcal; mass ≈ 180 + 30 + 200 = 410 g.
